results.title: Pagan festivals instead of Christian ones. The AfD’s programme that is mobilising the Church
results.description: At the June congress of Alternative für Deutschland (AfD), a proposal was put to the vote aimed at replacing Christian holidays with German neo-pagan celebrations, starting with the winter and summer solstices. These would be proper public holidays, with shops, schools and offices closed and celebrations taking place across the country.
